name: 3D Gaussian Splatting (glTF KHR_gaussian_splatting)
definition: A rendering method treating 3D Gaussian splats as point primitives, defined by position, rotation, scale, opacity, and spherical harmonics for diffuse/specular color, stored in glTF mesh primitives.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a glTF extension that renders 3D Gaussian splats as point primitives with strict data layouts, ensuring interoperability and fallback to sparse point clouds.
